# Optimize help command: auto-generated help

How: derive help text from a command table and sync README automatically; Why: prevent docs drift and keep UX consistent.

## Implementation plan

- Define a static command metadata table (name, about, usage, flags) and generate clap subcommands/help from it, ensuring a single source of truth.
- Add a `tk help --markdown` (or similar) mode that emits README-ready command docs; wire a small script/test to assert README contains the generated section to avoid drift.
- Ensure help output includes default values and value enums, matching clap configuration; keep backward-compatible command names.
